items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: my brother... said, they had him open that thing in the back so I could, I could listen to those guys... Zooty did that

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Yeah. So. Well, you, you were telling me yesterday about the 100 block of North Rampart, how you couldn't get in that place where Zooty was. I didn't get in there.

Yeah. I told you that. Yeah. I told you, my brother, my brother brought me in the front and he says, take off your hat here. He says, cause there's the best of the best in that place. Mm-hmm. And he says, I'm going in there, have a band, I'll have Zooty open that window around in the back alley. Mm-hmm. There's an alley in the back of all those places. Mm-hmm. So, Zooty did that and, and, and that, that's what happened. Because I had long pants on at that time, cause I used to go and dance on the boat with these…
